import sys

MOD = 998244353

def mod_mul(a, b):
    return (a * b) % MOD

def mod_pow(a, e):
    return pow(a, e, MOD)

def mod_inv(a):
    return pow(a, MOD - 2, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])

    cnt = r - l + 1
    cells = n * m

    if (n & 1) and (m & 1):
        ans = mod_pow(cnt, cells)
    else:
        p = mod_pow(cnt, cells - 1)
        if (cnt & 1) == 0:
            ans = mod_mul(p, cnt // 2)
        else:
            term1 = mod_mul(p, (cnt + 1) // 2)
            term2 = mod_mul((p - 1) % MOD, mod_inv(2))
            ans = (term1 - term2) % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
